notes: Discount classes (AR_ST_ITEM_CLASSES + AR_ST_ITEMS_DISC): same tables as generated, legacy column order, general-class flag; class number max + 1, a name, one general class, lines (group / unit / retail price / MOH discount of the item, price 0..99999.99, non-negative discounts, no repeated item), Excel load button (APP_RULES3_SA). Wave 3b: wrong automatic list AS_CLASS (asset classes) removed from CLASS_CODE; general-class check box; legacy item / unit lists (units of the item cascading); item name and unit factor on the lines.

row_rules.AR_ST_ITEMS_DISC:
-- legacy line WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM / PRE-INSERT: class, active group of the item, unit of the item (basic by default),
-- retail price and MOH discount by default, price 0..99999.99, non-negative discounts / bonus, no repeated item per class
app_rules3_sa.disc_line_row('AR_ST_ITEMS_DISC', inserting, :new.class_code, null, :new.item_group_code, :new.item_code, :new.unit_code,
  :new.sales_price, :new.disc_ratio1, :new.disc_ratio2, :new.disc_ratio3, :new.bonus_ratio, :new.extra_bonus_ratio);

AR_ST_ITEMS_DISC.ITEM_CODE.lov: select it.item_code || ' - ' || nvl(it.name_a, it.name_e) d, it.item_code r from st_item it, st_item_unit iu where nvl(it.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and it.item_group_code = iu.group_code and it.item_code = iu.item_code and nvl(iu.basic_unit, 0) = 1 order by 2

AR_ST_ITEMS_DISC.UNIT_CODE.lov: select u.unit_code || ' - ' || u.name_a || decode(iu.basic_unit, 1, ' (وحدة أساسية)', '') d, u.unit_code r from st_item_unit iu, st_unit u where iu.item_code = :PAGE_ITEM_CODE and (iu.group_code = :PAGE_ITEM_GROUP_CODE or :PAGE_ITEM_GROUP_CODE is null) and iu.unit_code = u.unit_code order by 2

AR_ST_ITEMS_DISC.ITEM_NAME.sql: (select max(nvl(i.name_a, i.name_e)) from st_item i where i.item_code = t.item_code and i.item_group_code = t.item_group_code)

AR_ST_ITEMS_DISC.NDB_FACTOR.sql: (select max(u.factor) from st_item_unit u where u.item_code = t.item_code and u.group_code = t.item_group_code and u.unit_code = t.unit_code)
